diagnosis.summary: payment-service p95 latency has risen from 110 ms to 2900 ms, a 26x increase. order-service is reflecting that slowdown, with its own p95 latency at 2950 ms and a 5xx error rate of 16.7%. The incident has been active for 2 minutes.
diagnosis.root_cause: A severe slowdown inside payment-service, active while order-service calls it synchronously on every POST /orders, is the most likely root cause.
evidence: payment-service p95 latency rose 26x, from 110 ms at baseline to 2900 ms in the current window.
order-service p95 time spent calling payment-service rose from 112 ms to 2950 ms, matching payment-service's own p95 latency, indicating the time is spent inside payment-service.
order-service dependency_error_count rose from 0 to 57 per minute, meaning 57 calls to payment-service failed or timed out in the latest window.
order-service 5xx error rate rose from 0.0 to 0.167, meaning 16.7% of requests to order-service are now answered with a server error.

order-service p95 end-to-end latency rose from 130 ms to 2950 ms, a 23x increase, consistent with requests waiting on the slow payment dependency. Payment-service p95 latency rose above its baseline at 14:32:00 and order-service 5xx errors rose above baseline 40 seconds later at 14:32:40 (observed sequence from correlated timestamps).
recommended_actions: Check payment-service CloudWatch Logs (anomalypulse-payment) and lambda_duration_ms_mean to identify what is making the handler slow or failing it internally.
Check payment-service lambda_throttle_count and cold_start_count in CloudWatch; if throttling is present, assign reserved concurrency to payment-service.

Note that dependency_latency_ms_p95 at 2950 ms is approaching order-service's 6 s read timeout; calls that reach the timeout will also fail, so resolving payment-service slowness is urgent before the timeout is hit at scale.
Do not add retries to order-service's payment call while payment-service is struggling, as each retry adds another invocation and extends wait time.
After each remediation step, recheck order-service dependency_error_count and error_rate_5xx to confirm recovery.
